title: What happened in AI — Oct 5, 2026
intro: Agent tooling filled in the operational layer today: AWS shipped an inference-tuning skill for coding agents, and GitHub, Elastic and Akka published concrete ways to evaluate and deliver agent work.
On the model side, DeepSeek dominated coverage, and OpenAI detailed EU text watermarking and a new ChatGPT ad format.
highlights: GitHub launched ReviewBench, an open benchmark for AI code-review agents.
AWS added an aws-ai-ml skill so Claude Code, Codex and Kiro can tune SageMaker inference.
Elastic shared how it unified agent evals, mixing LLM-as-a-judge with deterministic rules.
Open-source Hindsight (memory) and Recursant (routing) target agent builders.
DeepSeek V4.1-Flash reportedly hits 494 tokens/s on four DGX Spark units.
OpenAI outlined EU text-watermark rules and a new ChatGPT ad format.
